shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated, evenly spaced units
small oval or disc-shaped elements set into a plain field
rounded outlined forms in low relief / heavy contour
rectangular field bounded by a straight edge
justification: The only real correspondence is the use of a horizontal register of repeated, similarly sized rounded units running across the top of a rectangular field, with smaller isolated oval/disc forms scattered in the field below, and profile animal-like heads appearing in both. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, ink-drawn, fully enclosing frame of dense glyph-like cartouches around a single large hatched disc, while B is a photographed stone relief with sculpturally modelled quadrupeds and a bird arranged freely in open space, with no encircling border and no dominant central disc.
